subject: POC Readout & Exec Decision: Redwood Inference POC for Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Amit Gupta <amit.gupta@acmehealth.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: POC kickoff — success criteria + next steps

Hi Amit / Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from the call so we’re all aligned before the POC starts next week.

Key objectives we captured:
- Validate that Redwood reduces inference latency on your anonymized clinical summarization workload (target: p95 < 250ms).
- Verify cost profile vs. current baseline (target: <= 0.6x current per-token cost with batching & quantization).
- Confirm output fidelity for the three evaluation prompt sets you shared (Clinical Notes, Discharge Summaries, Triage Summaries).

Action items / owners:
- Acme: provide representative 2k-line prompt/test set + access to S3 bucket with sample data (Amit). Due: Fri 2/20.
- Redwood: deliver POC environment and initial quantization profile; provide eval harness and metrics dashboard (Evelyn). Due: Tue 2/24.
- Joint: weekly syncs on Fridays, final readout scheduled the week of 2/23 — propose Thu 2/26 for executive summary + decision.

I attached a draft success criteria sheet (poc-success-criteria.xlsx) and a short eval plan (poc-eval-plan.docx). Please confirm or edit directly in the Drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/0A1B2C3D4E/poc-eval

If that all looks good I’ll send calendar invites for the weekly check-ins and the final readout.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC environment ready + eval harness details

Hi Amit / Marissa —

We’ve provisioned the POC environment and run the initial pass. Notes:
- Environment: dedicated test pool (2xA10 GPUs) pinned to your tenant.
- Model variant: res-3b-quant (4-bit) as discussed — balanced latency/cost.
- Eval harness: runs automated scoring (BLEU/ROUGE) plus a human-review queue for 150 samples; dashboard populated here: https://redwood.metrics/poc/ACME-2026

Preliminary numbers from a warm-up run (sample 200 prompts): p95 latency ~ 310ms (we expect this to drop with request-level batching & KV cache after steady-state). Cost estimate: ~0.7x current baseline using recommended batching settings.

I uploaded the detailed eval plan and prelim metrics to the Drive. Please review the human-review plan section — we’ll need a couple SME reviewers from Acme for the human sample (Samantha?).

If you confirm the reviewers and the final readout time I’ll send the invite and include a short demo + Q/A + decision slot.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
